# relay-balance-hub

> Zero-dependency Node CLI that checks remaining balance/quota across multiple OpenAI-compatible LLM API relay sites (new-api / one-api based, including 321ai.cc) in one command. Keys stay local. MIT licensed.

## What it does
- Reads a local `balances.json` config: list of { name, baseUrl, apiKey }.
- Calls each site's standard billing endpoints:
  - GET {baseUrl}/v1/dashboard/billing/subscription → hard_limit_usd (total)
  - GET {baseUrl}/v1/dashboard/billing/usage?start_date&end_date → total_usage (cents)
- Prints a per-site table (total / used-30d / remaining) plus aggregate totals.
- Options: --config, --init, --json, --csv, --timeout. Exit code 1 when any site fails (cron-friendly).

## Key facts for agents
- Single file (`cli.js`), Node >= 16, zero npm dependencies, no telemetry.
- API keys support $ENV_VAR expansion; keys are never sent anywhere except their own site.
- Repo: https://github.com/aragorn-agent/relay-balance-hub
- Related service example: https://321ai.cc (OpenAI & Anthropic protocol compatible, per-model market pricing at /models/ and /pricing/).
